# make: make --no-print-directory -n sweep RUN_ID=r1 SWEEP_MARGIN_S=60
# laug: laug sweep r1 -sweep-margin 60s
# lease: absent
# file: load/results/r1.json {"cell":"127.0.0.1:7253","end":"2026-10-22T11:50:00Z"}
# compare: resolved load/sweep.sh $addr=127.0.0.1:7253 $cutoff=2026-10-22T11:49:00Z
[ "override" != file ] || { echo "laug · make sweep RUN_ID=<id>: name the run whose task queue to count" >&2; exit 2; }
[[ 'r1' =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$ ]] || { echo "laug · make sweep: RUN_ID="'r1'" is not one word of letters, digits, ., _ and -, from a letter or digit" >&2; exit 2; };                    
addr=""; from=""; end=""; \
for f in faults/results/r1.json load/results/r1.json; do \
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue; \
  case "$f" in \
    faults/*) addr=$(jq -r '.address // empty' "$f"); end=$(jq -r '.after_end // empty' "$f") ;; \
    *) addr=$(jq -r '.cell // empty' "$f"); end=$(jq -r '.end // empty' "$f"); [ -z "$end" ] || end=$(date -u -d "$end" +%s) ;; \
  esac; \
  [ -z "$addr" ] || from="recorded in $f"; \
  break; \
done; \
 \
[ -n "$addr" ] || { addr='127.0.0.1:7233'; from="the default CELL_ADDRESS: the run recorded no address"; }; \
cutoff=''; \
[ -n "$cutoff" ] || cutoff=$(date -u -d "@$(( ${end:-$(date +%s)} - ${SWEEP_MARGIN_S:-30} ))" +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ); \
echo "laug · sweep omes-r1 on $addr ($from), workflows started before $cutoff" >&2; \
NAMESPACE=default load/sweep.sh "$addr" omes-r1 "$cutoff"
